Title: D2: Keep NodeClient Projects Separate
Content: Decision D2 (locked, 2026-06-01): Keep NodeClient projects as independent class libraries. NodeClient.Ollama, NodeClient.Copilot, NodeClient.Worker, and NodeClient.LlamaCpp stay separate. Do NOT fold into Infrastructure. Rationale: each has distinct NuGet dependencies (Copilot pulls Azure.Identity + Key Vault SDK; LlamaCpp only needs Microsoft.Extensions.*) and not all deployments need all clients. This enables tree-shaking and keeps Machine B minimal.
